set.pl: Sac Bay neighbourhood, south Garden peninsula (secs 19-22 T38N R19W, Fairbanks Twp), about 12 km SW of Garden
pinev: 1900 census (Sack Bay Twp) lists him between households that the 1913 Delta atlas and patrons list place in secs 19 and 21 T38N R19W; his 1909 death record is Fairbanks Twp, which includes Sac Bay. No Koster tract on the 1913 atlas (he died 1909); the ring covers secs 19-22 (BLM PLSS). The 1909 Detroit News said only 'Garden', the nearest village.
set.t: House burned in 1909; coins could survive in the cellar hole. Access: unknown.
